name: in.enhanciar/enhanciar
title: Enhanciar — company brain
description: Ask your company's Slack, Gmail, Drive, Notion, Jira and code from any MCP client, with sources.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer dh_<api-key>. Create a key in Enhanciar (Settings → API keys). Plans at https://enhanciar.in/pricing

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.about: Enhanciar is a company brain for your whole team. Ask anything about your company in plain English and get the answer with a link to the source: it reads Slack, Gmail, Google Drive, Notion, Confluence, Jira, Linear, Zendesk, GitHub, databases and PDFs. Then hand it the follow-up: it drafts the reply, ticket, doc or calendar hold and waits for a person to approve. It also reviews pull requests and runs impact analysis (what breaks if this changes). Use it in the web app, in Slack, or from Claude, Cursor and any MCP client.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Answer a plain-English question about the company, with sources. Start here; it costs AI tokens on your own key. Use search_wiki + get_page for exact page text.

tools.name: search_wiki
tools.description: Find wiki pages containing a word or phrase. Exact match, no AI tokens. Returns name, title and a snippet for each hit (limit 1-50, default 20).

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read the full Markdown of one wiki page, by category + name or a path like concepts/billing-flow, from search_wiki or list_pages.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List every wiki page you can see (category, name, title). For a topic use search_wiki; for a question use query.

tools.name: get_graph
tools.description: The workspace's knowledge graph: topics, links and clusters, for the big picture rather than page content.

tools.name: impact
tools.description: What else breaks or needs retesting if you change a file or function: callers, callees, affected files and tests (depth default 2).

tools.name: list_repos
tools.description: The code repos ingested into the workspace, with branch and last ingest time. Check before asking about code.

tools.name: get_process_map
tools.description: Map of how the company works: procedures, the tools they use (GitHub, Slack, Jira) and the docs behind them.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List the team's recurring procedures (skills) Enhanciar wrote up; read one with get_skill.

tools.name: propose_action
tools.description: File a Jira, Linear or GitHub issue, Slack message, calendar hold, Gmail draft (never sent), Notion page or Zendesk note for a person to approve. Nothing runs until they do.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Read the full steps of one skill by its name from list_skills.

tools.name: list_proposed_actions
tools.description: The approval queue: actions waiting for a person, or already done. Filter by status. Read-only; check it before proposing to avoid duplicates.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.pricing: Paid plans: Solo $24/month, Team $100/month for up to 10 people, Enterprise custom. Monthly billing. Bring your own AI key with zero markup.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.auth: Authorization: Bearer dh_<key> — keys minted in the Enhanciar app (Settings → API keys).
